plugins.name: open-voice-shield
plugins.description: Fraud verdicts, route checks and caller-ID verification for every SIP call, operated by Claude: connect your switch, request test calls you confirm in the portal, read verdicts and transcripts, verify caller ID.

skills.name: cli-verification
skills.description: Verify caller ID delivery on a route with Open Voice Shield - check which countries are covered, run a CLI check that dials a number in the target country with a chosen caller ID and reports what arrived (match, modified, withheld, missing), and host a number to earn per check. Use when someone asks whether their caller ID is delivered intact, whether a vendor strips or rewrites CLI, or wants to enrol a number.
skills.description_zh: 用 Open Voice Shield 检查路线来电号码传递，查询国家覆盖并拨打测试号码，判断匹配、改写、隐藏或缺失，也可登记托管号码按测试获取收益。

skills.name: fraud-review
skills.description: Review analysed calls on Open Voice Shield - list calls scored block or review, read a call's verdict, red flags, transcript and PDF report, and act on the caller. Use when someone asks what was flagged overnight, why a call was blocked, what a caller said, or wants evidence for a complaint or a TCPA case.
headings: How to talk about a verdict
skills.description_zh: 审阅 Open Voice Shield 已分析的拦截或待审通话，读取判定、风险标记、转录及 PDF，并处理来电者；用于夜间异常、拦截原因和投诉证据。

skills.name: onboard
skills.description: Set up an Open Voice Shield account end to end with the MCP tools - sign in, the destination calls go on to, routing, IP whitelist, webhook, alerts, then a test call the person confirms that proves a verdict comes back. Use when someone wants to connect their switch, carrier or PBX to Open Voice Shield, or asks how to get started with call fraud analysis on a SIP trunk.
skills.description_zh: 通过 MCP 完成 Open Voice Shield 账号连接、呼叫目的地、路由、IP 白名单、webhook 和告警，最后以人员确认的测试电话验证返回判定。

skills.name: route-test
skills.description: Test a vendor route or a destination through Open Voice Shield - request a test call the person confirms, read post-dial delay, answer delay, estimated MOS, jitter and packet loss per leg, and any false answer supervision (FAS) alert. Use when someone asks whether a route is good, whether a carrier is cheating with fake answer, or wants to check call quality on a SIP destination.
skills.description_zh: 通过人员确认的测试电话检查 Open Voice Shield 供应商路线或 SIP 目的地，读取拨号与应答延迟、估算 MOS、抖动、丢包和虚假应答告警。
